title: A Remote Life in Toronto
story: Farhana Rahman, a data analyst from Dhaka, moved to Toronto three years ago. She works remotely for a company in London, so her day is shaped by time zones. Her husband Arif is a nurse who often works night shifts, and together they are trying to build healthier habits.
storyBn: ঢাকার মেয়ে ফারহানা রহমান একজন ডেটা অ্যানালিস্ট; তিন বছর আগে সে টরন্টোতে চলে এসেছে। সে লন্ডনের একটি কোম্পানির হয়ে দূর থেকে কাজ করে, তাই তার দিন চলে সময়ের ব্যবধানের হিসাবে। তার স্বামী আরিফ একজন নার্স, প্রায়ই রাতের শিফটে কাজ করে। দুজনে মিলে তারা স্বাস্থ্যকর অভ্যাস গড়ে তোলার চেষ্টা করছে।

units.focus: Habits and efforts that have been going on for a while
units.focusBn: কিছুদিন ধরে চলতে থাকা অভ্যাস ও প্রচেষ্টা

sessions.pattern: Subject + have / has been + verb-ing (+ for / since / lately).
sessions.tipBn: অতীতে শুরু হয়ে এখনো চলছে এমন কাজ বোঝাতে have/has been + verb-ing হয়, সাথে প্রায়ই for বা since থাকে।

items.en: Farhana has been waking up at 5:30 for three months so that she can overlap with her London team.
She has been keeping a sleep diary since her doctor mentioned signs of burnout.
Arif has been working night shifts at the hospital all month, so they barely see each other.
Lately, Farhana has been blocking two hours every morning for deep, uninterrupted work.
The couple has been experimenting with a digital curfew after 10 o'clock at night.
She has been drinking far less coffee since she noticed how badly it affected her sleep.

sessions.pattern: Subject + haven't / hasn't been + verb-ing (+ for / since / lately).
sessions.tipBn: কিছুদিন ধরে কোনো কাজ হচ্ছে না বোঝাতে haven't/hasn't been + verb-ing হয়।

items.en: Farhana hasn't been sleeping well since the clocks went back in November.
She hasn't been taking proper lunch breaks, which explains her afternoon headaches.
Arif hasn't been getting enough daylight because he sleeps through most of the day.
They haven't been eating dinner together as often as they used to.
Her team hasn't been respecting her working hours; messages keep arriving at four in the morning.
Farhana hasn't been going to the gym lately, but she has been walking along the lakeshore instead.

sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্ন করতে Have/Has শুরুতে বসে, তারপর subject, been ও verb-ing।

items.en: Have you been using that habit-tracking app you downloaded back in January?
Has Arif been sleeping any better since he bought blackout curtains for the bedroom?
Has Farhana been answering work messages on weekends again, even though she promised to stop?
Have you two been talking about moving to a city with a shorter commute?
Has the new standing desk been helping with the back pain you mentioned last month?
Have you been meditating every morning, or only when you feel stressed?

sessions.pattern: Wh- word + have / has + subject + been + verb-ing?
sessions.tipBn: How long দিয়ে জানতে চাওয়া হয় কাজটি কতদিন ধরে চলছে।

items.en: How long have you been working from home, and do you still enjoy it?
Why has Farhana been feeling so drained by the end of each week?
What have you been doing to switch off after a long day of video calls?
Who has been picking up the groceries since Arif switched to night shifts?
How much sleep have you actually been getting on weeknights since the project began?
Which productivity methods have you been trying, and which ones have actually worked?

sessions.pattern: 4 to 6 sentences, mostly have / has been + verb-ing.
sessions.tipBn: অনুচ্ছেদে কিছুদিন ধরে চলা অভ্যাস ও চেষ্টা বর্ণনা করতে বেশিরভাগ বাক্যে present perfect continuous থাকে।

items.title: The early shift
items.en: For the past three months, Farhana has been starting her day before sunrise. Because her company is based in London, she has been scheduling her most important calls for the early morning. She has been going to bed by 9:30, which has meant turning down evening invitations from friends. Surprisingly, she has been feeling more focused than ever. Still, she wonders how long she can keep it up.

items.title: Two schedules, one home
items.en: Arif has been working nights at a Toronto hospital since September. He has been coming home at eight in the morning, just as Farhana is finishing her first meeting. They have been leaving sticky notes on the fridge to stay in touch. On his days off, they have been trying to share at least one meal. It hasn't been easy, but they have been learning to value small moments together.

items.title: Breaking the scroll habit
items.en: Farhana has been trying to break her habit of scrolling through social media in bed. For two weeks, she has been charging her phone in the kitchen instead of on her nightstand. She has been reading paper books again, and she has been falling asleep noticeably faster. Arif, meanwhile, has been teasing her about her old-fashioned alarm clock.

units.focus: What had already happened before key moments of the day
units.focusBn: দিনের গুরুত্বপূর্ণ মুহূর্তের আগেই যা ঘটে গিয়েছিল

sessions.pattern: Subject + had + past participle (+ by the time / before / after / when ...).
sessions.tipBn: অতীতের দুটি ঘটনার মধ্যে যেটি আগে ঘটেছিল, সেটিতে had + past participle হয়।

items.en: By the time Farhana woke up, her London colleagues had already sent dozens of messages.
Arif had just fallen asleep when the construction work started next door.
She realized she had left her laptop charger at the co-working space.
After she had finished her morning run, she felt ready for the toughest meeting of the week.
Before moving to Canada, Farhana had worked in a busy Dhaka office with a two-hour commute.
Arif had set three alarms because he had overslept the week before.

sessions.pattern: Subject + hadn't / had never + past participle.
sessions.tipBn: অতীতের কোনো সময়ের আগে কাজটি হয়নি বোঝাতে hadn't বা had never + past participle হয়।

items.en: Farhana hadn't eaten anything by noon, so she felt dizzy during the client call.
Arif hadn't slept properly for days when he finally took a sick day.
She hadn't realized how much time she wasted on email until she tracked it.
Before their first Canadian winter, they had never experienced such short, gloomy afternoons.
Nobody had told her that the meeting had been moved to 6 o'clock.
She hadn't taken a proper vacation in two years before last winter's trip to Sylhet.

sessions.tipBn: Hadn't দিয়ে প্রশ্ন করে বোঝানো হয় যে বক্তা ধরে নিয়েছিল কাজটি আগেই হয়ে গিয়েছিল।

items.en: Hadn't you already finished the report before your manager extended the deadline?
Hadn't Arif just come home when the hospital called him back in?
Hadn't you tried working from a cafe before you rented the co-working desk?
Hadn't she promised herself that she would stop working after 6 o'clock every day?
Hadn't they agreed to keep phones out of the bedroom before the argument started?
Hadn't the power come back by the time you started your first call?

sessions.pattern: Wh- word + had + subject + past participle ...?
sessions.tipBn: Wh- শব্দের পরে had, তারপর subject ও past participle বসে।

items.en: What had Farhana already done by the time Arif got home from his shift?
Why had she stopped exercising before her doctor gave her that warning?
How many hours had Arif slept before he had to go back to the ward?
Where had they lived before they found their apartment near the lake?
Which habits had you already changed before the new year officially began?
When had you last taken a full day off before this long weekend?

sessions.pattern: 4 to 6 sentences, mostly had + past participle.
sessions.tipBn: অনুচ্ছেদে কোনো ঘটনার আগে কী ঘটে গিয়েছিল তা বোঝাতে বেশিরভাগ বাক্যে past perfect থাকে।

items.title: A rough Monday
items.en: By the time Farhana opened her laptop on Monday, her London team had already held two meetings without her. She had slept through her alarm because she had stayed up late watching a series. Worse, she hadn't prepared the slides she had promised. She apologized and presented anyway. By lunchtime, she had learned a hard lesson about Sunday nights.

items.title: Why the new routine worked
items.en: Farhana's new routine worked because she had prepared for it carefully. Before starting, she had moved her desk next to the window and had deleted three social media apps. Arif had agreed to take over the evening cooking. She had also told her manager about her new focus hours. By the end of the first month, she had finished every project on time.

items.title: Arif's long night
items.en: When Arif finally got home at nine in the morning, he had been awake for nearly twenty hours. The emergency room had been unusually busy, and two nurses had called in sick. He hadn't eaten since midnight. Farhana had left a plate of rice and dal on the table with a note. He smiled, ate quickly and fell asleep before he had even taken off his socks.

units.focus: How routines, schedules and systems are organized
units.focusBn: রুটিন, সময়সূচি ও কাজের ব্যবস্থা কীভাবে সাজানো হয়

sessions.pattern: Subject + be (is / was / has been / will be / is being) + past participle (+ by ...).
sessions.tipBn: কে কাজটি করে তার চেয়ে কাজটি বেশি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হলে be + past participle দিয়ে কর্মবাচ্য হয়।

items.en: Almost all of the team's meetings are scheduled around London business hours.
Farhana's weekly tasks are organized in a shared online planner every Monday.
Arif's shift schedule for December was released only two days in advance.
Her standing desk has finally been delivered, three weeks after she ordered it.
Employees will be encouraged to log off by 6 o'clock under the new policy.
Her sleep patterns are being tracked by a smartwatch for a research study.

sessions.tipBn: কর্মবাচ্যে not বসে be-এর পরে, যেমন aren't expected, weren't delivered।

items.en: Remote workers aren't expected to reply to messages outside their working hours.
The weekly groceries weren't delivered on Saturday because of the heavy snowstorm.
Farhana's request for a four-day week hasn't been approved by HR yet.
Night-shift nurses at Arif's hospital are not given enough time to recover between shifts.
The late-night notifications won't be sent anymore once the new settings are saved.
None of her lunch breaks were interrupted last week, which felt like a small miracle.

sessions.pattern: Is / Was / Has / Will + subject + (been / be) + past participle ...?
sessions.tipBn: কর্মবাচ্যের প্রশ্নে is/was/has/will শুরুতে বসে, আর মূল verb থাকে past participle রূপে।

items.en: Are all team meetings recorded for people in different time zones?
Was the stand-up meeting moved to a later time because of Farhana's complaint?
Has Arif been told whether he will be moved to day shifts next month?
Will her new ergonomic chair be delivered before the end of the month?
Is overtime paid when Arif is asked to stay after his shift?
Were you affected by the power outage that hit the neighborhood last night?

sessions.pattern: Could you tell me / Do you know / I wonder + wh- word / if / whether + subject + passive verb ...
sessions.tipBn: পরোক্ষ প্রশ্নে সাধারণ বাক্যের মতো subject আগে আর verb পরে বসে; is/was সামনে চলে আসে না।

items.en: Could you tell me when the weekly schedule is usually shared with the team?
Do you know whether lunch breaks are counted as working hours at your company?
I wonder if Arif will be given any time off during the holidays.
Would you mind telling me how the new flexible-hours policy was decided?
Can you find out whether a desk has been reserved for me at the co-working space?
I'd like to know why my afternoon emails are always answered the next morning.

sessions.pattern: 4 to 6 sentences, mostly passive verbs in different tenses.
sessions.tipBn: অনুচ্ছেদে কাজ কীভাবে করা হয় তা বোঝাতে বিভিন্ন কালের কর্মবাচ্য ব্যবহার হয়।

items.title: Working across time zones
items.en: Farhana's team is spread across three countries, so its day is carefully planned. Important decisions are made during a short window when everyone is online. All calls are recorded, and short summaries are posted in a shared channel. Tasks are assigned every Monday, and progress is reviewed on Thursdays. Because of this system, nobody is expected to work late.

items.title: A night on the ward
items.en: At Arif's hospital, the night shift is organized very strictly. Patients are checked every two hours, and all medicines are recorded on a tablet. At six in the morning, the day team is briefed about every patient. Arif was praised last week because a serious problem was noticed early during his shift. Small moments like that make the long nights worthwhile.

items.title: The new flexible policy
items.en: Last month, a new flexible-hours policy was introduced at Farhana's company. Core hours have been reduced to four, and the rest of the day can be arranged freely. Meetings will no longer be booked on Friday afternoons. Employees are being asked to share their preferred schedules by the end of the week. So far, the change has been welcomed by almost everyone.

units.focus: Past choices and their effects on today's routine
units.focusBn: অতীতের সিদ্ধান্ত ও আজকের রুটিনে তার প্রভাব

sessions.pattern: If + had + past participle, would have + past participle. / If + had + past participle, would + verb (now).
sessions.tipBn: অতীতে যা ঘটেনি তার কল্পনায় third conditional, আর অতীতের কারণে বর্তমানের ফল বোঝাতে mixed conditional ব্যবহার হয়।

items.en: If Farhana had set clearer boundaries earlier, she would have avoided burning out last spring.
If Arif had taken that clinic job two years ago, he would be sleeping at normal hours now.
If they had stayed in Dhaka, they would probably spend three hours a day in traffic.
Had she known about the time difference, she would have negotiated different working hours.
If I had gone to bed at ten last night, I would feel much sharper this morning.
She would have joined the call on time if her alarm had gone off at 5:30.

sessions.pattern: If + hadn't + past participle, wouldn't have + past participle / wouldn't + verb.
sessions.tipBn: যেকোনো অংশে hadn't বা wouldn't বসিয়ে কল্পিত অতীত বা বর্তমানকে না-বোধক করা যায়।

items.en: If Farhana hadn't started walking every evening, she wouldn't have discovered the lakeshore trail.
Arif wouldn't be so exhausted now if he hadn't agreed to cover an extra shift.
If she hadn't moved abroad, she wouldn't have learned to cook for herself.
If they hadn't bought blackout curtains, Arif wouldn't be able to sleep during the day.
Farhana wouldn't have missed the deadline if she hadn't been checking her phone every five minutes.
If she had never tracked her screen time, she would never have noticed the problem.

sessions.pattern: Wh- word + would (have) + subject + verb ... + if + had + past participle?
sessions.tipBn: would have দিয়ে অতীতের কল্পিত ফল, আর would দিয়ে বর্তমানের কল্পিত ফল জানতে চাওয়া হয়।

items.en: What would you have done if your company hadn't allowed remote work?
How would your life be different now if you had stayed in Dhaka?
Where would Farhana be working today if she hadn't accepted the London offer?
Which habit would you have started sooner if you had known its benefits?
Who would have looked after the plants if you had gone to Sylhet for a month?
How much more rested would you feel today if you had switched off your laptop at seven?

sessions.pattern: 4 to 6 sentences with third and mixed conditionals.
sessions.tipBn: অনুচ্ছেদে অতীতের সিদ্ধান্ত নিয়ে ভাবতে third ও mixed conditional ব্যবহার হয়।

items.title: Lessons from burnout
items.en: Last spring, Farhana worked twelve-hour days for two months and eventually burned out. If she had taken regular breaks, she might have noticed the warning signs sooner. If her manager had checked in more often, the problem would have been spotted earlier. Looking back, she believes that if she had said no to one big project, she would be healthier today. Now she protects her evenings carefully.

items.title: The job Arif almost took
items.en: Two years ago, Arif was offered a day job at a small clinic, but he turned it down for a higher salary. If he had accepted it, he would be having breakfast with Farhana every morning now. On the other hand, he wouldn't have met the colleagues who have become his closest friends. He often wonders which choice would have made him happier.

items.title: One small decision
items.en: Three years ago, Farhana almost stayed in her Dhaka job. If she hadn't applied for the remote position, she would still be sitting in traffic every evening. She wouldn't have discovered how much she loves early mornings. And if Arif hadn't encouraged her, she would never have taken the risk. Sometimes one small decision shapes an entire daily routine.
